reason: I already paid for salon software once and my girls never touched it, so I cancelled. I count the drawer myself every night and the register works, so ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month for something they may ignore again is not worth it for me.
objection: My staff won't do the selfie check-in and type every bill in a busy hour. They'll go back to the register in two weeks and I'll still be paying ₹999 a month, even in slow months.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, and I only pay after one month where my staff actually billed everything through the app, so I can see it works in my salon first.
